sentences.text:
(At Present Lodged In District Jail Chittorgarh)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. X W/o X, R/o Turkiya Kalla, Ps Kapasan, District Chittorgarh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram, PP  Mr. Gopal Singh Bhati for the  complainant  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 10/07/2025 1. Heard and perused the material available on record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed by petitioner under Section 483 B.N.S.S. in connection with FIR No.160/2024 dated 20.05.2024 registered at Police Station Kapasan, District Chittorgarh for the offences under Sections 363, 366, 343, 379, 376(3) IPC and Section 5 (L)/6 of POCSO Act and under Sections 3(2), (VA) SC/ST Act.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case while alleging that the petitioner has committed rape upon the complainant's daughter.

While drawing attention of the Court towards the statement of complainant (PW-3), he submits that she Sarif Mohamad vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:29979) on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13617873/
1 has not supported the prosecution story and has turned hostile while submitting that the petitioner has neither committed any wrong with her daughter nor he lured her and took her [2025:RJ-JD:29979] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-7015/2025] along with him.

sentences.text:
He further submits while drawing attention of the Court towards the statement of complainant's daughter (PW-1), wherein in her examination-in-chief, she has stated that the petitioner has committed rape upon her, however,
in her cross examination, she has denied the allegations and stated that the petitioner has not committed any wrong with her and he has not forcibly taken her, thus, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
4.

Learned counsel for the complainant submits that the complainant (PW-3) has not supported the prosecution story and has turned hostile and complainant's daughter (PW-1) has also stated in her cross examination that the petitioner has not committed any wrong with her.

5. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes the bail application, however, is not in a position to refute that complainant (PW-3) has not supported the prosecution story and has turned hostile and complainant's daughter (PW-1) has also stated in her cross examination that the petitioner has not committed any wrong with her.

6. After careful consideration of the submissions made by the parties and having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case as available on record and looking to the fact that the trial will consume time and without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.

7. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 483 B.N.S.S. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Sarif Mohamad S/o Shri Amirdin, arrested in relation to FIR No.160/2024 dated 20.05.2024 registered at Police Station Kapasan, District Chittorgarh shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction [2025:RJ-JD:29979] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-7015/2025] of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
